effect_description_eng:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [Counter] [Once Per Turn] You may delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as many digivolution cards as this Digimon or fewer.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by trashing 2 same-level cards from its digivolution cards, it doesn't leave.
